text:
Alex: Clearing out some gear before the move this weekend. Up for grabs: Varidesk Pro Plus 36 (good condition, a couple of scuffs, no wobble) and a potted fiddle-leaf fig (about 3ft tall, needs bright indirect light). Also have 2x Sunday muni weekend passes (unused). Would rather someone local pick up from SOMA office tonight or tomorrow morning. Photos: https://imgur.com/variplant

Jules: Interested in the Varidesk. Does it come with the riser legs and the keyboard shelf?

Alex: Yep both included. Keyboard shelf slides smoothly. I'll leave a small toolkit and the mounting screws taped underneath.

Dana: Fig plant sounds perfect. Any tips on watering? I'm terrified of killing plants. :grimacing:

Alex: It's pretty forgiving. Water when top 1-2 inches of soil feels dry, likes humidity. I'll leave a sticky note with care instructions.

FacilitiesBot: FYI: building doors lock at 7pm. After-hours pickups require a facilities escort. Book freight elevator for bulky items.

Jules: I can pick up the Varidesk tonight around 6pm. Will bring two people to help lift. DMing number.

Marta: If Jules can't make it, I can take the Varidesk Sat morning. Also happy to adopt the plant if Dana passes.

Dana: I can do plant pickup tomorrow before 11am if that works. Thanks Alex!

Alex: Great. I'm going to label the Varidesk box "For Jules" and put the plant on the north storage shelf with a Post-it "For Dana". Muni passes I'll leave at front desk in an envelope labeled "Marta/Alex".

Jules: Claimed the Varidesk. Thanks Alex! Will use the freight elevator and bring blankets to protect the surface.

Dana: Claimed the plant for tomorrow morning. I'll bring a tote and some cardboard to protect leaves. Thanks!

Marta: If there's a leftover muni pass after pickup, please ping me. Might swing by Sunday.

Alex: Will do. If anything changes I'll post here. Thank you all  feels good to place these with folks who'll use them. :seedling: :handshake:

(Reaction: Alex's message got a :heart: from Jules)
